kept_facts.fact: If Foo Co. sells 210 units during November, the total cost of sales under FIFO would be $11,050.
Under FIFO, the total cost of sales for November would be $11,050.
The ending inventory under FIFO would be calculated at $5250.
Under LIFO, the total cost of sales for November would be $11,800.
The balance sheet would show $4500 in inventory under LIFO.
The difference between the cost of an inventory calculated under the FIFO and LIFO methods is called the LIFO reserve.

kept_facts.fact: Goodwill is recognized when a firm is purchased as a going concern.
To calculate goodwill, the fair market value of acquired assets and liabilities is deducted from the purchase price.
If company A acquired company B and paid $20, goodwill would be $11 ($20 - $9).
Goodwill is considered to have an indefinite useful life under U.S. GAAP and IFRS for public companies.
Goodwill can only be impaired under current GAAP standards.
